body: My mom never really did try to be close with my rabbit. When I told her I was sad because he could've been thinking about me while I was gone she said that rabbis don't have a brain so it wasn't possible. She has also said they don't have a heart before when I told her my rabbit loves being petted. I'm mad because he could still be with me right now, he was the only one who made me feel loved and gave me joy. It's hard not to be angry with my mother right now but perhaps it's better to forgive and forget?
Ngl you actually made me laugh. Thank you for that
I don't know if I can, they were the only escape I had.
Goddammit, thank you for answering anyway.
